<p><b>Pufferfish</b> are <a href="/w/Bucket_of_aquatic_mob" class="mw-redirect" title="Bucket of aquatic mob">bucketable</a> aquatic <a href="/w/Neutral_mob" class="mw-redirect" title="Neutral mob">neutral mobs</a> found in <a href="/w/Ocean" title="Ocean">oceans</a>. Although they never seek out mobs to attack, they defensively inflate themselves when approached too closely by <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">players</a>, <a href="/w/Axolotl" title="Axolotl">axolotls</a>, or non-aquatic mobs, dealing damage and inflicting <a href="/w/Poison" title="Poison">Poison</a> on them.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Spawning">Spawning</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?section=1&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Spawning" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section's source code: Spawning"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, pufferfish spawn in groups of 1-3 in warm, lukewarm, and deep lukewarm ocean biomes, subject to <a href="/w/Fish#Spawning" title="Fish">fish spawning requirements</a>. If trying to spawn inside a waterlogged solid block, the pufferfish uses the bigger "puffed" size to determine if it collides with anything solid.
</p><p>In <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, pufferfish spawn underwater at around 12–32 blocks away from the player in groups of 3–5 in <a href="/w/Warm_ocean" class="mw-redirect" title="Warm ocean">warm ocean</a> biomes, and only on the surface; that is, there must not be a spawnable block above the spawn location with a non-solid block on top. They are considerably rarer than tropical fish, with only <sup>1</sup>⁄<sub>5</sub> of fish groups or <sup>2</sup>⁄<sub>9</sub> individual fish (within the warm ocean biome) spawning as pufferfish.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Behavior">Behavior</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?section=4&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Behavior" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section's source code: Behavior"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Unlike other <a href="/w/Fish" title="Fish">fish</a>, pufferfish don't swim in schools.
</p><p>Pufferfish inflate themselves when approached by the player and most mobs, including <a href="/w/Tripod_camera" class="mw-redirect" title="Tripod camera">tripod cameras</a>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition and Minecraft Education"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">BE</a> & <a href="/w/Minecraft_Education" title="Minecraft Education">edu</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> and <a href="/w/Armor_stand" class="mw-redirect" title="Armor stand">armor stands</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>The player may collect a fish by <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">using</span> a <a href="/w/Water_bucket" class="mw-redirect" title="Water bucket">water bucket</a> on it, giving the player a <a href="/w/Bucket_of_pufferfish" class="mw-redirect" title="Bucket of pufferfish">bucket of pufferfish</a>. Fish placed with buckets do not despawn naturally. <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">Using</span> the bucket against a block empties the bucket, placing water with that fish swimming in it.
</p><p>Pufferfish can not be bred and only spawn in designated biomes.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Weaknesses">Weaknesses</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?section=5&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Weaknesses" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section's source code: Weaknesses"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Like other fish, pufferfish cannot survive out of water. Outside of water, they flop around like <a href="/w/Guardian" title="Guardian">guardians</a> for a while until they start suffocating and then die like <a href="/w/Squid" title="Squid">squid</a>. In <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, they rotate when flopping. Fish cannot swim or breathe in cauldron water.<sup id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-3"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>The <a href="/w/Impaling" title="Impaling">Impaling</a> enchantment affects pufferfish due to being aquatic‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Java Edition"><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">Java Edition</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> or simply being in water.‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">Bedrock Edition</a>  only</span></i>]</sup>
</p><p>Pufferfish are actively targeted by <a href="/w/Axolotl" title="Axolotl">axolotls</a>, <a href="/w/Nautilus" title="Nautilus">nautiluses</a> and <a href="/w/Zombie_nautilus" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombie nautilus">zombie nautiluses</a>.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Defenses">Defenses</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?section=6&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Defenses" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section's source code: Defenses"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>A pufferfish inflates when approached by a player in <a href="/w/Survival" title="Survival">Survival</a> or <a href="/w/Adventure" title="Adventure">Adventure</a> mode, a <a href="/w/Drowned" title="Drowned">drowned</a>, an <a href="/w/Axolotl" title="Axolotl">axolotl</a>, or any non-water mob within 2 blocks of its hitbox, going from unpuffed, then semi-puffed, to fully puffed. Going near a semi-puffed or fully puffed pufferfish inflicts the player/mob with three or six seconds of <span class="nowrap"><span class="sprite-file" style="height:18px;width:18px"><span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/Poison" title="Poison"><img alt="" src="/images/EffectSprite_fatal-poison.png?7a152" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="18" height="18" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="18" data-file-height="18"></a></span></span><a href="/w/Poison" title="Poison"><span class="sprite-text">Poison</span></a></span> based on the inflation level, and touching one in its puffed or semi-puffed form deals damage separate from the Poison.
</p><p>Pufferfish also instantly inflate to their fullest form after taking any kind of damage.‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">Bedrock Edition</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> After inflating, they slowly deflate to their normal shape as long as a threat is out of range. If the player/mob leaves the radius while the pufferfish is in its semi-puffed stage, it deflates back to normal.
</p><p><a href="/w/Undead" title="Undead">Undead</a> mobs are unaffected by the Poison effect, but they still take damage when they come into contact with pufferfish.
</p><p>A pufferfish that inflicts damage on a mob other than a creeper or a ghast by touching it provokes that mob to retaliate.
</p><p>In <a href="/w/Peaceful" class="mw-redirect" title="Peaceful">Peaceful</a> difficulty, pufferfish do not inflict damage or Poison to player.‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Java Edition"><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">Java Edition</a>  only</span></i>]</sup>
</p><p>Pufferfish can deal damage to players at a longer distance compared to mobs.<sup id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>If a pufferfish dies while in its semi-puffed or fully puffed form, it will still inflict damage and Poison to players, but not other entities.<sup id="cite_ref-5" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-5"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>5<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>

<p>Pufferfish have entity data associated with them that contains various properties.
</p><p><i><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">Java Edition</a></i>:
</p>
<div role="note" class="hatnote searchaux">Main article: <a href="/w/Entity_format" title="Entity format">Entity format</a></div>
<div class="treeview">
<ul><li><span title="NBT Compound / JSON Object"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-48px -16px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[NBT Compound / JSON Object]</span></span> Entity data
<ul><li class="mw-empty-elt"></li><li class="treeview-header nbttree-inherited load-page" data-page="Template:Nbt inherit/entity/template" data-template="true" data-treeview="true" data-treeviewclass="nbttree-inherited">Tags common to all entities<span class="noscript"> see <a href="/w/Template:Nbt_inherit/entity/template" title="Template:Nbt inherit/entity/template">Template:Nbt inherit/entity/template</a></span><span class="mw-editsection-like load-page-button" style="min-width: 38px;">[<span class="jslink">show</span>]</span></li>
<li class="mw-empty-elt"></li><li class="treeview-header nbttree-inherited load-page" data-page="Template:Nbt inherit/mob/template" data-template="true" data-treeview="true" data-treeviewclass="nbttree-inherited">Tags common to all mobs<span class="noscript"> see <a href="/w/Template:Nbt_inherit/mob/template" title="Template:Nbt inherit/mob/template">Template:Nbt inherit/mob/template</a></span><span class="mw-editsection-like load-page-button" style="min-width: 38px;">[<span class="jslink">show</span>]</span></li>
<li><span title="Byte"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-0px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Byte]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> FromBucket</span>: 1 or 0 (<code>true</code>/<code>false</code>) - if <code>true</code>, the fish has been released from a bucket.</li>
<li><span title="Int"><span class="sprite nbt-sprite" style="background-position:-48px -0px;background-size:64px auto;height:16px;width:16px"></span><span class="hidden-alt-text">[Int]</span></span><span class="nowrap" style="font-weight: bold;"> PuffState</span>: A value from 0–2.
<ul><li><code>0</code> means the fish is deflated</li>
<li><code>1</code> means it is halfway puffed-up</li>
<li><code>2</code> means it is fully puffed-up</li></ul></li></ul></li></ul>
</div>
<p>A pufferfish's damage and Poison time are directly related to its current <code>PuffState</code> data value, which can be changed using the <code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/data" title="Commands/data">data</a></span></code> command.

<td><a href="/w/Notch" class="mw-redirect" title="Notch">Notch</a> mentioned that <a href="/w/Fish" title="Fish">fish</a> might be a feature of <a href="/w/Coral" title="Coral">coral</a>, if he were able to add coral: "... I do know that the corals will have tiny fish particles around them."</td></tr><tr><th rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a href="https://web.archive.org/web/0/https://notch.tumblr.com/post/1243370641" class="extiw" title="wordofnotch:1243370641">October 4, 2010</a></th>
<td>Fish were a passive <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mob</a> that <a href="/w/Notch" class="mw-redirect" title="Notch">Notch</a> showed interest in adding. In the promotional graphic for the <a href="/w/Halloween_Update" title="Halloween Update">Halloween Update</a>, Notch indicated he would add fish. However, they were added only as an <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">item</a>; there was no code for a fish mob.</td></tr><tr><th rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://twitter.com/Dinnerbone/status/253954758489038848">October 5, 2012</a></th>
<td><a href="/w/Fish" title="Fish">Fish</a> were jokingly teased in the fake snapshot <a href="/w/12marc40awesome" class="mw-redirect" title="12marc40awesome">12marc40awesome</a>, along with <a href="/w/Coral" title="Coral">coral</a> and "fish blocks".</td></tr><tr><th rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://reddit.com/r/Minecraft/comments/s7ri6/i_am_jon_k%C3%A5gstr%C3%B6m_developer_of_minecraft_ask_me/c4bs6d1?context=3">April 13, 2013</a></th>
<td>When <a href="/w/Jon_K%C3%A5gstr%C3%B6m" title="Jon Kågström">Jon Kågström</a> was asked in his AMA on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reddit" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:Reddit">Reddit</a>, "What <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mob</a> would you like to implement into the game?" He responded, "I would like to add birds, fish and tree animals to make it more alive. However this will take some time before it can be done."</td></tr><tr><th rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://reddit.com/r/Minecraft/comments/xfzdg/i_am_markus_persson_aka_notch_creator_of/">July 31, 2013</a></th>
<td>During <a href="/w/Notch" class="mw-redirect" title="Notch">Notch</a>'s AMA on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reddit" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:Reddit">Reddit</a>, when asked about what happened to his plans of adding fish as a <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mob</a>, he responded, "Oh yeah, the fish!"</td></tr></tbody></table>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Trivia">Trivia</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?section=20&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Trivia" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Pufferfish?action=edit&section=20" title="Edit section's source code: Trivia"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<ul><li>In real life, pufferfish use their spikes for intimidation purposes and do not inject venom. Some of their organs and skin is toxic, which is <a href="/w/Pufferfish_(item)#Food" title="Pufferfish (item)">reflected accurately</a> in-game.</li>
<li>There are three textures for the three different <code>PuffState</code> data values in <i>Minecraft</i>. A <code>PuffState</code> value greater than 2 does not visually increase the pufferfish size, but does create a bigger shadow on the ground. All sizes of pufferfish textures are contained in the same texture file.</li></ul>
